Images inside specified tags stay inline

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Text <img src='icon.png' alt='icon'> more text</p>", HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(keep_inline_images_in: ['p']))
puts result.content.inspect
```
